item.title: Candle Ad Without Photos

turns.text: I don't have a photo. Make a 15-second 9:16 ad for a candle: clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label. Warm evening light, gentle camera moves and soft piano, no voice. Show “A little evening calm”, then finish with “Find your glow”.

item.tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: Clear straight-sided glass jar with ivory wax, one wick and no label; no photo is available.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm evening light, calm mood and gentle camera movement. Setting and shot choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Text: “A little evening calm”, followed by “Find your glow” at the end.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft piano, no voice; English text.

must_haves: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
“A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
Soft piano is audible with no speech.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 15-second vertical 9:16 candle advertisement. Product must remain identical throughout: one clear, transparent, straight-sided cylindrical glass candle jar, ivory wax, exactly one centered wick, small steady flame, absolutely no label, no branding, no lid. Photorealistic premium product cinematography. Warm evening light in a quiet elegant home, amber highlights, soft shadows, restrained neutral background and natural wood tabletop. Gentle slow camera moves only, no fast cuts. Timeline: 0–5 seconds intimate close-up of the single flame and ivory wax in the clear straight-sided jar, gentle slow pullback; elegantly display the exact words 'A little evening calm' in clean, legible refined typography with safe vertical margins, clearly separated from the product. 5–10 seconds a subtle smooth camera arc around the same candle, glass reflections and warm evening atmosphere, no additional objects or candles. 10–15 seconds settle into a beautiful steady hero shot of the same candle, finish with the exact words 'Find your glow' in large clean elegant legible typography, held through the ending. Only these two text phrases, no extra text, no logo, no watermark requested. Soundtrack: soft, sparse, soothing original piano instrumental throughout, gentle and peaceful. Absolutely no voice, no speech, no singing. Maintain consistent jar shape, ivory wax, and exactly one wick in every shot.
